The requester's blocks, newest first.

Around and up for a conversation: zone, spot line, optional position, hour or day, or keep to leave the stored end as it is. With ble: true it also starts Bluetooth proximity; in derived-v1 the response carries the new ble_key (the one new field of v1).
routes.notes: ble_key is new in v1 (docs/contracts/ble-tokens.md) and is sent only by backends whose capabilities say ble.mode derived-v1. The legacy ble { token, rotate_at } is sent only in server-rotate mode. A backend serving both during the transition may send both. until: 'keep' is an optional addition to v1, sent only to backends whose capabilities say people.presence_keep_until: it keeps the stored presence_until (never past the end of the conference) and never starts presence, with or without ble and with any zone, spot or location; the response echoes until: 'keep'.

Optional. Store this app's APNs device token or FCM registration token for the requester's profile at one conference, so the nudge reaches the app while it is closed. A device has one registration per platform and conference; a new token replaces the old one.
routes.notes: Call it only when the capabilities flag of the platform is true. A backend that does not push to the platform answers 404 push_unavailable and stores nothing; a backend without the route answers 404 Not found. Either way the app falls back to in-app nudges.
